descriptionHtml:
DeepCool EX750 High Performance Thermal Paste (3g)

​The DeepCool EX750 is an industrial-grade thermal interface material (TIM) engineered for enthusiast-level cooling. It is designed to minimize thermal resistance between high-performance CPUs/GPUs and their cooling solutions.

​Technical Specifications

  • ​Thermal Conductivity: 6.2 W/m·K

  • ​Thermal Impedance: 0.03°C·cm²/W

  • ​**Specific Gravity (25°C): 2.6 g/cm³

  • ​Operating Temperature Range: -50°C to +250°C

  • ​Grease Color: Gray

  • ​Net Weight: 3 grams (typically provided as 2x 1.5g syringes in some packaging)

​Physical Properties

  • ​Consistency: Smooth, gel-like consistency designed for easy spreading and filling of microscopic surface imperfections.

  • ​Electrical Conductivity: Non-conductive (Safe for use near electronic components; prevents short circuits).

  • ​Corrosiveness: Non-corrosive and non-toxic.

​Key Highlights

  • ​Low Thermal Resistance: Optimized for high-heat scenarios like overclocking or intensive rendering, ensuring maximum heat transfer to the heatsink.

  • ​Stability: Highly stable compound that does not dry out or bleed easily under long-term high-temperature exposure.

  • ​Application: Suitable for both Desktop and Laptop applications (CPU and GPU).

  • ​Volume: The 3g quantity is generally sufficient for multiple applications (approximately 5–10 standard CPU applications depending on the method used).

​Package Contents

  • ​1x (or 2x) Syringe of EX750 Thermal Paste.

  • ​1x Spreader/Spatula (usually included for even application).
  • ​Cleaning wipes (included in some retail versions for surface preparation).
